pages.convergenceRule: sourceSha must equal the successful CI attestation testedSha and the Pages workflow expected SHA

aiProxy.automaticTrigger: successful main CI attestation; deploy if the exact per-push Worker scope changed or if cumulative changes from the live sourceSha include Worker runtime/config files
aiProxy.manualRedeploy: requires a successful main CI run id and its exact-SHA attestation
aiProxy.rollback: capture the active 100-percent version and /health sourceSha before deploy; on failed smoke, roll back that version and verify its prior sourceSha
aiProxy.convergenceRule: coalesced or canceled runs are recovered by comparing live sourceSha through the exact CI-attested SHA only when that SHA is still current main head and the live SHA is its ancestor; stale workflow_run events and newer/divergent live Workers are never rolled back; main head is rechecked immediately before deployment

fastDataPlane.automaticTrigger: successful main CI attestation; deploy if the exact per-push Worker bundle/config changed or if cumulative changes from the live sourceSha include a data-plane bundle dependency/config
fastDataPlane.manualRedeploy: requires a successful main CI run id and its exact-SHA attestation
fastDataPlane.rollback: capture the active 100-percent version and /health sourceSha before deploy; on failed smoke, roll back that version and verify its prior sourceSha
fastDataPlane.convergenceRule: coalesced or canceled runs are recovered by comparing live sourceSha through the exact CI-attested SHA and transitive data-plane module import graph only when that SHA is still current main head and the live SHA is its ancestor; stale workflow_run events and newer/divergent live Workers are never rolled back; main head is rechecked immediately before deployment
